loans_only.label: Loans only (memo Sec. II.D as written; sensitivity after sponsor decision)

unified.label: Unified base: loans + corporate bonds + municipal bonds (sponsor decision, Nov 22 2026)

comment: Input resolution for the MSF v2 consolidation engine. To swap in the cohort lane's UNIFIED-base outputs (loans + corporate bonds + municipal bonds) when they land, either (a) drop the files into one of the candidate locations below using the cohort runner's naming convention, or (b) edit the paths here. NO code change is required. The engine verifies provenance: a 'unified' summary whose FY2027 eligible stock does not exceed the loans-only eligible stock by more than 5% is rejected as mislabeled.
